item.title: Exceptional tests of general relativity with GW250114
item.description: In January 2025, the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration observed an exceptionally loud gravitational-wave signal: GW250114. It stands out as the clearest one observed thus far, about three times louder than the first detection in 2015. item.title: Celebrating BepiColombo, three words at a time
item.description: Video: 00:03:32 BepiColombo launched on 20 October 2018. This year, the anniversary is special.
